group.label: Voice Input
group.comment: Speak to the assistant instead of typing. Speech is converted to text by the browser's own speech recognition, so the audio is handled by the browser vendor (for example Google for Chrome), never by Mago or the AI provider. The resulting text is treated exactly like typed text.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Show a microphone button in the chat panel. Speech is turned into text by the browser's own speech recognition, so the audio is handled by the browser vendor (e.g. Google for Chrome), not by Mago or the AI provider. The recognised text is editable and treated exactly like typed text. Only shown in browsers that support speech recognition.

field.label: Language
field.comment: The language the browser listens for. Speaking another language than the one selected here gives garbled text, so pick the language administrators actually speak rather than the interface language.

field.label: Voice Mode
field.comment:
Dictate: press the microphone, speak, check the text and press Send yourself.
Send after a pause: press the microphone once. After each pause a bar counts down and sends the message; say a yes word to send at once, a no word to clear it, or keep talking to add more.
Confirm each message: press the microphone once. After each pause a bar asks "Send this message?" and waits: say a yes word (or click Send) to send, a no word (or Discard) to clear it, or keep talking to add more.
In both, the microphone is paused while the assistant answers and then listens again for your next message. Press the microphone, start typing or say a stop word to end it. Admins can also switch mode from the chat itself.

field.label: Send Delay (ms)
field.comment: Used by Send after a pause (also when an admin picks it in the chat): how long the bar counts down after you stop talking before the message is sent, in milliseconds (default 1400). Gives time to say a no word or keep talking. 0 sends at once.

field.label: Turn Off After Silence (seconds)
field.comment: Send after a pause and Confirm each message keep the microphone open between messages. After this many seconds without any speech it turns itself off, so it does not keep listening to the room when nobody is talking to the assistant. Time spent waiting for an answer does not count. 0 keeps it on until it is turned off by hand (default 8).

field.label: Yes Words
field.comment: Send the message while the bar is up, and press Allow on a confirmation card (spoken, or typed as a short reply; a card that cannot be undone still needs its box ticked by hand first). Comma-separated words in your own language (the one set under Language above), added to the built-in English words, which always keep working. The first word you enter is the one the panel suggests. Use ordinary words the speech recognition knows: invented words or phrases are written down differently each time and will not be recognised.

field.label: No Words
field.comment: Clear the message while the bar is up, and press Reject on a confirmation card. Comma-separated words in your own language (the one set under Language above), added to the built-in English words, which always keep working. The first word you enter is the one the panel suggests. Use ordinary words the speech recognition knows: invented words or phrases are written down differently each time and will not be recognised.

field.label: Stop Words
field.comment: Said on their own, these turn the microphone off in any mode. There is deliberately no spoken "start". Comma-separated words in your own language (the one set under Language above), added to the built-in English words, which always keep working. The first word you enter is the one the panel suggests. Use ordinary words the speech recognition knows: invented words or phrases are written down differently each time and will not be recognised.
